combo1.title: A Modern First Turn: Swordsoul, Step by Step
combo1.description: A real modern first turn, with every step labelled with the word players use for it. Two cards in hand, Swordsoul of Mo Ye and Swordsoul Strategist Longyuan, become two Synchro Monsters that can stop up to three of your opponent's plays, and Ash Blossom stays in your hand. Every card here can be played at three copies in the TCG (as of 5 October 2026).

steps.text: STARTER · Normal Summon Swordsoul of Mo Ye. That uses your one Normal Summon for the turn.
steps.customText: STARTER · Normal Summon Swordsoul of Mo Ye. That uses your one Normal Summon for the turn.

steps.text: CHOKE POINT · Activate effect: Mo Ye was Normal Summoned, so you reveal Swordsoul Strategist Longyuan from your hand to Special Summon a Swordsoul Token. Revealing is the cost, and Longyuan stays in your hand. If your opponent negates Mo Ye right now with Effect Veiler or Infinite Impermanence, there is no Token and the combo stops. Ash Blossom can't stop it, because the Token doesn't come from the Deck.

steps.text: TOKEN · A Swordsoul Token, a Level 4 Tuner, is Special Summoned. LOCK: while it's on the field, Synchro Monsters are the only monsters you can Special Summon from your Extra Deck.
steps.customText: TOKEN · A Swordsoul Token, a Level 4 Tuner, is Special Summoned. LOCK: while it's on the field, Synchro Monsters are the only monsters you can Special Summon from your Extra Deck.

steps.text: MATERIAL · The Swordsoul Token is used as Synchro Material. Tokens never reach the GY; they simply vanish.
steps.customText: MATERIAL · The Swordsoul Token is used as Synchro Material. Tokens never reach the GY; they simply vanish.

steps.text: MATERIAL · Swordsoul of Mo Ye goes to the GY as the other Synchro Material. Level 4 + Level 4 = 8.
steps.customText: MATERIAL · Swordsoul of Mo Ye goes to the GY as the other Synchro Material. Level 4 + Level 4 = 8.

steps.text: Synchro Summon Swordsoul Grandmaster - Chixiao, a Level 8 Synchro Monster. Synchro Monsters can go straight into a Main Monster Zone.
steps.customText: Synchro Summon Swordsoul Grandmaster - Chixiao, a Level 8 Synchro Monster. Synchro Monsters can go straight into a Main Monster Zone.

steps.text: CHAIN · Activate effects: Chixiao's Summon and Mo Ye going to the GY as Synchro Material trigger at the same time, so both go on one chain. You pick the order: Chixiao's search is Chain Link 1 and Mo Ye's draw is Chain Link 2, so the draw resolves first.
steps.customText: CHAIN · Activate effects: Chixiao's Summon and Mo Ye going to the GY as Synchro Material trigger at the same time, so both go on one chain. You pick the order: Chixiao's search is Chain Link 1 and Mo Ye's draw is Chain Link 2, so the draw resolves first.

steps.text: DRAW · Chain Link 2 resolves: Mo Ye draws you 1 card. That's a free card, a +1.
steps.customText: DRAW · Chain Link 2 resolves: Mo Ye draws you 1 card. That's a free card, a +1.

steps.text: SEARCH · Chain Link 1 resolves: Chixiao adds Swordsoul of Taia from your Deck to your hand. Chixiao gets one effect per turn: this search now, and its negate on your opponent's turn.
steps.customText: SEARCH · Chain Link 1 resolves: Chixiao adds Swordsoul of Taia from your Deck to your hand. Chixiao gets one effect per turn: this search now, and its negate on your opponent's turn.

steps.text: COST · Discard Swordsoul of Taia to activate Swordsoul Strategist Longyuan's effect in your hand. Its cost is discarding another Swordsoul card, and that's why Chixiao searched one.
steps.customText: COST · Discard Swordsoul of Taia to activate Swordsoul Strategist Longyuan's effect in your hand. Its cost is discarding another Swordsoul card, and that's why Chixiao searched one.

steps.text: EXTENDER · Longyuan Special Summons itself from your hand. It couldn't start this combo alone, but it keeps it going after your first Synchro.
steps.customText: EXTENDER · Longyuan Special Summons itself from your hand. It couldn't start this combo alone, but it keeps it going after your first Synchro.

steps.text: TOKEN · Longyuan then Special Summons another Swordsoul Token, a Level 4 Tuner, with the same lock.
steps.customText: TOKEN · Longyuan then Special Summons another Swordsoul Token, a Level 4 Tuner, with the same lock.

steps.text: MATERIAL · The second Swordsoul Token vanishes as Synchro Material.
steps.customText: MATERIAL · The second Swordsoul Token vanishes as Synchro Material.

steps.text: MATERIAL · Swordsoul Strategist Longyuan goes to the GY as Synchro Material. Level 6 + Level 4 = 10.
steps.customText: MATERIAL · Swordsoul Strategist Longyuan goes to the GY as Synchro Material. Level 6 + Level 4 = 10.

steps.text: Synchro Summon Swordsoul Sinister Sovereign - Qixing Longyuan, a Level 10 Synchro Monster.
steps.customText: Synchro Summon Swordsoul Sinister Sovereign - Qixing Longyuan, a Level 10 Synchro Monster.

steps.text: BURN · Activate effect: Longyuan was sent to the GY as Synchro Material, so your opponent takes 1200 damage. Their Life Points drop from 8000 to 6800.
steps.customText: BURN · Activate effect: Longyuan was sent to the GY as Synchro Material, so your opponent takes 1200 damage. Their Life Points drop from 8000 to 6800.

steps.text: END BOARD · You end your turn with two Synchro Monsters. On your opponent's turn, Chixiao can negate a monster's effects by banishing Swordsoul of Taia from your GY, and Qixing Longyuan can banish one monster they Special Summon and one Spell or Trap card they activate, with 1200 damage each time. That's up to three interruptions, and Ash Blossom is still in your hand as your handtrap.
